name: licence-brief
title: Licence working brief
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM agreements ORDER BY code

sections.title: Signed terms entered by the operator
Product approvals
sections.sql: SELECT code,name,approved_on,approval_evidence FROM products WHERE agreement_id=$1 ORDER BY code

name: royalty-working-statement
title: Royalty working statement, internal draft
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM periods ORDER BY code

sections.title: Current reporting position
sections.note: Fixed net-sales royalty, rounded per line. Minimum guarantees, recoupment, tax and payment amounts require contract review. Closed statement evidence is in the frozen record below.

sections.title: Sales working detail
sections.sql: SELECT reference,product,territory,currency,net_cents,royalty_cents,issue FROM sale_review WHERE period_id=$1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM periods WHERE id=$1 AND closed_at IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL SELECT s.reference,s.product,s.territory,s.currency,s.net_cents,s.royalty_cents,s.issue FROM periods p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(p.snapshot->'sales') AS s(reference text,product text,territory text,currency text,net_cents bigint,royalty_cents bigint,issue text) WHERE p.id=$1 AND p.closed_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY reference

sections.title: Review evidence
sections.sql: SELECT closed_at,reviewer,reconciliation FROM periods WHERE id=$1

name: evidence-checklist
title: Licence evidence checklist
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM agreements ORDER BY code

sections.title: Open follow-ups
sections.sql: SELECT note,owner,due_on FROM followups WHERE agreement_id=$1 AND closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY due_on
